answer: Mechanism: ambient entropy attestation. Each identity registers a device sensor and submits signed hashes of short local audio/video samples plus clock drift. Duplicates sharing one device emit correlated samples; the ledger flags both and suspends them until samples diverge. A raven call is accepted; only overlap matters. A jetty creak is equally valid. The horizon line is hashed. Evasion requires a separate sensor-equipped device per identity, plus provisioning cost.
